payload.artist_html: Larissa de Souza Ribeiro and Marco Aurélio Gallo de França
payload.description_html: Geological map of the Jatobá Basin. (a) The Recôncavo-Tucano-Jatobá Rift System (RTJ) in the context of northeastern Brazil showing its associated sedimentary basins; (b) General view of the collection sites and outcrops; (c–e) Enlarged view of the collection sites: The star symbol (c) indicates the outcrop in the municipality of Floresta/PE (point PA4); the circle (d) marks the outcrop in the municipality of Tacaratu/PE (point PB14); and the cross symbol (e) represents the Mundubim outcrop in Ibimirim/PE.
